notes.title: New patch coming soon
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We have been reviewing the feedback received, and we have managed to locate several bugs that we will fix soon with a new patch. Some of them are localisation bugs (like a few phrases that appear in Spanish even if we have English selected), some weirder bugs that can cause us to get stuck in a level, as well as some minor bugs. We're also working on improving the Lackey so that we can easily attract him even if he's far behind in the level, which can cause awkward situations.


We hope to have the patch out soon - thanks for your feedback!


the Not so Great team.

notes.title: Finally on sale!
notes.notes: Well, it's been quite a journey. 4 years in total since we started the first prototypes and concepts of the game until today, finally, we release it for sale. Thanks to all of you who have been following the title, we sincerely hope you like the game. As a team of two people in the development we have faced many challenges to overcome, but step by step and with everyone's support we have managed to finish it, thanks for believing in us! Now it's your turn to enjoy the game :).
